WisconsinKiosk · redesign row G (G3–G6)

Kiosk Return: Damaged or Missing

One quiet link on the return screen opens its own page: damaged means describe it and take a photo, and the item is held for staff; missing means mark it and tell staff, and the return can finish without it. The receipt names each.

Side by side

Before = HEAD c9e71a91 build, after = working tree; same created simulator, same fixture co-1.

New frames (after only)

No before exists: the kiosk had no report page and the return receipt was a single sentence.

What changed, and why

G3 chooser

Was

Nothing at the kiosk; web only.

Now

Its own page from one link: pick a serialized item, then It's damaged / It's missing.

G4 damaged

Was

—

Now

Multipart POST /api/kiosk/checkin/{id}/report (type DAMAGED, description, optional JPEG under 4.5 MB). Still counts as returned; the server holds the asset for staff. The row reads 'Held for staff'.

G5 missing

Was

—

Now

type LOST. Counted as accounted for: the Finish pill reads 'N back · 1 missing', the still-out check skips it, and if it was the last item out the server finishes the return and the kiosk goes straight to the receipt.

G6 receipt

Was

Sentence-only 'All 4 items returned.'

Now

Receipt cards: Returned (count, tags, ref), then Held for staff and Marked missing.

Verification

  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk on iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5 (created device): BUILD SUCCEEDED
  • npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- : 19 files / 60 tests passed (new tests/ios-kiosk-return-reports.test.ts checks the multipart fields and Codable keys against the route and service)
  • git diff --check clean

Things to know

  • The captures are fixtures and show layout only. They do not prove a report reached the server, the photo upload, staff notification, or the asset moving to MAINTENANCE.
  • Camera capture and the photo upload are device-only and unverified.
